canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Kelu Grelan: 41-year-old man, 150 cm (very-short), sturdy stocky construction with a broad frame and compact proportions, skin value band-2-light. Face: round full face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: multicolor-split-streak, curls-coils-halo, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette ochre-cream. Visible personal details: one mismatched earring; a tiny nose stud; a narrow bracelet stack. Make one clasp, buckle, piercing, or piece of hair hardware the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a polished seed case only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
